events.title: The chart comes out
events.markdown: The night's measures, drawn as isobars and fronts.

events.title: The team reads it
events.markdown: Before leaving the depot, the team reads the fronts on their route.

events.title: On the mast
events.markdown: Wind under thirty knots: the climb goes ahead.

events.title: The front passes
events.markdown: Showers and a turning wind: everyone comes down.

events.title: Back up
events.markdown: Clear sky behind the front: the work ends before dusk.

props.markdown: That is a day read from the chart.
